# CreateTOTALLY

> CreateTOTALLY is a creative automation platform for brand, marketing, and creative production teams. You turn Figma and Adobe design files into templates, plan every version you need, and the platform produces them for you. AI assistants and developers work with it through our MCP server, WebMCP in the web app, and a public API.

## What the platform does

- Design apps: Figma, Adobe InDesign, Adobe After Effects, Adobe Photoshop, and Adobe Illustrator.
- Templates: upload your design files, then choose which text, images, video, and audio can change.
- Content plans: plan versions by campaign, market, language, and format, in the app or from an Excel file.
- Automation: every version is produced from your original design files, so the output stays true to the design.
- Copy and translation: export a template's text to Excel for translation and import it back. AI can translate, rewrite, shorten, or change the tone of copy.
- Review and approval: share proofs, collect comments, and approve versions in one place.
- Libraries: keep approved images, video, audio, and copy in shared libraries.
- Delivery: send finished files where they need to go.
- Integrations: connect to tools such as Adobe Workfront and Monday.com.

## MCP server

AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor work in CreateTOTALLY through our MCP server.

- MCP URL: https://mcp.app.prod.createtotally.io/mcp
- Each user signs in with their own CreateTOTALLY account, and the assistant works with that user's permissions.
- Companies with their own dedicated CreateTOTALLY environment get its MCP URL from their CreateTOTALLY contact.

An assistant connected to the MCP server can:

- find templates and see which text, image, video, and audio layers can change, with their character limits
- find images, video, and audio in the shared library and use them in adaptations
- look up placements, formats, and languages
- create content plans and add adaptations to them
- read a content plan and its adaptations
- submit adaptations for automation
- propose new or changed placements and formats, which a person approves in CreateTOTALLY before anything is saved

## WebMCP

The CreateTOTALLY web app supports WebMCP. An AI assistant in the browser can:

- create content plans and import them from a spreadsheet
- add, edit, and submit adaptations, and generate copy for them
- review proofs, approve them, or request changes
- manage shared assets, media plans, and integrations

## Public API

The CreateTOTALLY API is a GraphQL API for connecting your own systems to CreateTOTALLY.

- Upload master template files and analyse them for automation.
- Create automation jobs that change text, images, video, and audio, then track each job until it's complete.
- Webhooks: we call your URL when an upload, analysis, or automation job completes or fails, and when files are delivered.
- Authenticate with an API key, in the `api-key` HTTP header or with HTTP Basic Auth.
- Access is by invitation. Ask your CreateTOTALLY contact, or [get in touch](https://www.createtotally.com/get-started).

## Features

- [Easy templating](https://www.createtotally.com/features/easy-templating.md): turn existing Figma and Adobe designs into reusable templates, locked to your brand
- [Creative automation](https://www.createtotally.com/features/creative-automation.md): scale creative production without losing quality or brand consistency
- [Workflow automation](https://www.createtotally.com/features/workflow-automation.md): automate creative operations from brief to final delivery
- [Libraries and asset management](https://www.createtotally.com/features/libraries-and-asset-management.md): manage creative assets, their usage, and distribution from one place
